initialExam.title: ESIC UDC (Upper Division Clerk) 2026
initialExam.description: ESIC UDC recruitment for clerical posts in ESI hospitals and offices providing social security to workers.
initialExam.syllabus: Prelims: Reasoning (25Q), Quant (25Q), English (25Q), GK (25Q). Mains: Reasoning (40Q), Quant (40Q), English (40Q), GK (40Q), Computer (40Q).
initialExam.examPattern: Prelims: 100Q, 100 marks, 1 hour. Mains: 200Q, 200 marks, 2 hours. Computer Skill Test.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Prelims → Mains → Computer Skill Test → Document Verification
initialExam.jobRole: Upper Division Clerk in ESIC offices and hospitals
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit esic.nic.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical (ESI), Transport Allowance, Pension
